jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Enterprise Change Management
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, we are committed to empowering our customers by providing the technology, resources, and community they need to thrive. While our roots are in food service, we are rapidly expanding into adjacent markets and international territories. Our mission is to build a world-class publishing and configuration platform that supports the diverse needs of all Toast customers, regardless of their industry, location, or the size of their business.

As a member of the Configuration Platform team, you will be at the heart of Toast’s most critical infrastructure. We are the high-concurrency engine powering live system updates across the entire Toast ecosystem. This platform powers how business-critical data is created, versioned, and deployed across Toast—from menus and pricing to taxes and operational rules. Whether it’s a menu change in Ireland or a pricing update for a 100 location enterprise, it all flows through our systems. We give customers the confidence and precision tools they need to manage complex configurations and run their global businesses with ease.

Beyond serving end-users, we are an ever-evolving internal platform. We aim to empower other Toast engineering teams to build, deploy, and scale their own features quickly on top of our robust architecture.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our configuration and change management experience across the Toast platform. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to craft an experience that supports our customers and the needs of their business.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

- Own and evolve the product strategy for Toast’s configuration platform, with a focus on:

- Designing systems that safely manage changes to critical business data, including validation, versioning, auditability, and rollback at scale

- Building and evolving a configuration platform that works for SMB, multi-unit operator, and Enterprise use cases across the Toast experience

- Exploring and integrating automation and AI-assisted (‘agentic’) workflows into configuration and publishing experiences

- Build platform capabilities that enable other Toast teams to develop, test, and deploy configuration-driven features independently

- Build and maintain a roadmap in alignment with business OKRs, customer needs, and technical feasibility

- Drive feature development from ideation through launch—writing clear specs, collaborating with engineering and design, and measuring success

- Partner with customer-facing teams and other development teams to gather insights and evangelize product value

- In partnership with engineering and design counterparts, lead a development team by providing clear direction, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, and accountability

- Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- 8+ years of product management experience, including significant ownership of a technical platform or infrastructure products

- Strong track record of delivering user-facing features in fast-paced environments

- Experience working on systems involving APIs, data models, or distributed architecture

- Analytical rigor—you use data to make decisions and validate assumptions

- Empathy for restaurants and a passion for improving their day-to-day

- Excellent communication skills and ability to influence without authority

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Vision AI
jobs.description:
This Role can be based in California OR Remote in CST

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast serves hundreds of multi-unit brands, including Caribou Coffee, Firehouse Subs, Tacos Palenque, Choice Hotels, Craveworthy Brands, WaBa Grill, Nothing Bundt Cakes, Papa Gino's & D'Angelo, Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill, and The Human Bean. As part of the Enterprise Drive-Thru team, you'll help build the next generation of technology for some of the largest restaurant brands in the industry. You can read more on our Toast for Enterprise page and Toast Drive-Thru page.

Drive-thrus are at the forefront of restaurant AI innovation. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager, Vision AI to define and build computer vision and camera-powered products at Toast, including vehicle intelligence, operational analytics, and new AI-powered restaurant experiences.

Vision AI will be your primary focus, with broader influence across Enterprise Drive-Thru. You'll work across software, AI, hardware, and restaurant operations to identify opportunities, make strategic investments, and bring new products from concept to scale.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

- Own the Vision AI product vision and strategy. Define the long-term roadmap for capabilities including vehicle detection, identification, tracking, timing, operational intelligence, and new camera-powered experiences.

- Drive zero-to-one product development. Lead discovery, prototyping, pilots, commercialization, and scaling of new AI and drive-thru products in highly ambiguous problem spaces.

- Help shape Enterprise Drive-Thru strategy. Develop a deep understanding of large, multi-location restaurant brands and identify opportunities where Toast can build differentiated solutions beyond Vision AI.

- Own hardware-enabled experiences. Define the hardware ecosystem required to support Vision AI and Drive-Thru products, including cameras, media players, networking, digital menu boards, and emerging technologies.

- Lead customer research and field validation. Spend time with Enterprise customers and in restaurants understanding operational workflows, validating solutions, and translating insights into product strategy.

- Drive technology and partner decisions. Evaluate camera systems, computer vision platforms, AI vendors, and architectural approaches. Lead trade-offs across build vs. buy vs. partner, cloud vs. edge, performance, cost, complexity, scalability, and customer value.

- Drive commercialization and adoption. Partner with GTM teams on packaging, positioning, pricing inputs, pilots, and rollout strategies that drive customer outcomes and Enterprise growth.

- Lead across the organization. Influence Engineering, Design, Hardware Operations, Security, Legal, Customer Care, Sales, Product Marketing, and senior leadership to align teams around strategy and execution.

- Embrace AI-first product development. Use AI tools to accelerate discovery and execution while identifying new ways AI can create value for restaurants and guests.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- Product leadership experience. 8+ years of Product Management experience owning complex products, significant product areas, or multi-team initiatives from strategy through scale.

- AI and emerging technology experience. Experience delivering AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, computer vision applications, or adjacent emerging technologies.

- Zero-to-one leadership. Proven ability to take ambiguous opportunities from discovery through prototype, pilot, commercialization, and scale.

- Enterprise product experience. Experience building for large, complex customers while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product investments.

- Technical fluency. Ability to partner deeply with Engineering and Hardware teams on architecture, integrations, AI systems, and technical trade-offs.

- Strategic decision making. Ability to balance customer impact, performance, scalability, operational complexity, development investment, and economics when defining product direction.

- Customer obsession. Experience conducting deep customer discovery, field research, and pilots with strategic customers.

- Vendor and partner strategy. Experience evaluating technology vendors and making build vs. buy vs. partner decisions.

- Leadership and influence. Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to align senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams around a product vision.

Special Sauce* (Nice to Haves)

- Experience with computer vision, camera systems, video analytics, or machine learning products, especially real-time video.

- Experience building products that combine software and hardware.

- Familiarity with AI model evaluation, experimentation, and performance measurement.

- Experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, automotive, transportation, or other operationally complex environments.

- Familiarity with drive-thru operations or multi-location restaurant technology.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product, International
jobs.description:
Toast is driven by building a platform that helps our customers adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. International expansion is a critical growth engine for Toast's future.

Outside the US, we currently operate in Canada, UK, Ireland, and Australia and are actively growing our share in these markets. As we move into the next phase of growth, the complexity of our platform surface area and customer segments is increasing materially. We are looking for a commercially-minded (Senior) Director of Product Management to enable this growth.

As a (Senior) Director of Product, International, you will lead the team of product managers to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap around upmarket expansion to support larger (15+ locations) groups, accelerating integration partner availability to ensure customers can use Toast alongside their preferred tech stack, and  expansion of our FinTech / payments pricing capabilities. Scaling and managing these domains require someone who can work credibly with customers, GTM teams, engineers, executive stakeholders, and external partners in equal measure.

This is a London based-role, partnering closely with teams across Canada, Australia, U.S., Ireland, and India, and a key part of our EMEA leadership team. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of how Toast serves customers in new markets.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

- Drive Strategy and Execution: Set the strategic direction across upmarket, partner, and payment expansion with a focus on how those areas interact and reinforce each other to meet the north star goals for the International line of business. Partner with engineering and product teams across Toast's platform teams to ship international features in their area. Navigate competing roadmaps, set clear success criteria, and hold delivery against contractual commitments.

- Voice of Customer: Engage directly with customers, partners, and GTM teams to understand real needs — and use that grounding to pressure-test roadmap priorities and push back on assumptions that don't hold up in the field. Represent the voice of international customers as the PM voice for our global restaurant and hospitality brands in roadmap discussions, cross-functional reviews, and executive conversations.

- Lead Through Influence: Champion cross-functional delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Legal/Compliance, Hardware, Commerce, Risk, Finance, and Operations. This role has direct exposure to C-suite leadership and regular involvement in executive-level roadmap and strategy discussions.

- Develop a World-Class Team and OS: Hire, coach, and develop a world-class team of Product Managers across multiple regions. Scale our operating model grounded in ownership, accountability, clarity, and exceptional execution.

- Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- 15+ years of product management experience in SaaS or FinTech, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. You've owned a portfolio of products for a market, not just a feature area.

- Commercial instincts. You understand how product decisions translate into revenue, retention, and customer value, and you make prioritization decisions accordingly.

- Comfort with ambiguity at the charter level — you have shaped product direction from scratch, not just executed against someone else's vision.

- A track record of working across a complex stakeholder map — engineering, GTM, finance, external partners — that do not report to you. You are comfortable driving alignment without losing sharpness in the process.

- Strong people leadership. You build teams, give direct feedback, develop careers, and hold a high bar for product thinking without micromanaging execution.

- Excellent written and verbal communication — crisp strategy docs, strong product reviews, and the ability to represent platform work clearly to executives and customers alike.

- Experience managing product commitments that are tied to enterprise contracts or MSAs.

- Genuine curiosity about the restaurant industry. You don't need to have run a restaurant, but you should want to understand how an operator thinks and how that thinking should shape what you build.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Governance
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team at Toast is on a mission to deliver a trusted, scalable, and governed data foundation that empowers every team at Toast to make decisions with speed and confidence. As Toast scales and AI becomes central to our product and operational strategy, EDS serves as the engine behind that ambition—building the infrastructure, governance frameworks, and data products every business function depends on.

As a Senior Data Governance Product Manager, you will be the primary operational executor within EDS's governance function. Reporting directly to the Director of Enterprise Data Governance, you will build and run the policies, processes, and programs that make Toast's data trustworthy, compliant, and discoverable every day.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable running a cross-functional workshop with business stakeholders and configuring metadata standards in a data catalog—combining strategic thinking with a strong bias toward execution.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

- Drive Governance Program Operations: Manage and maintain the Data Domain Model, ensuring clear ownership assignments. Facilitate the Data Governance Council (agendas, action tracking, meeting facilitation), partner with Data Stewards across domains, and track program adoption metrics and maturity KPIs for leadership.

- Execute Policy & Compliance Standards: Support the development, documentation, and roll-out of enterprise data policies. Monitor compliance, coordinate remediation with domain owners, maintain the policy register, and assemble governance documentation for audits and risk reviews.

- Lead Business Glossary & Metadata Management: Own day-to-day operations of Toast's Business Glossary by facilitating definition workshops and certifying terms with domain owners. Partner with the data catalog team to enforce metadata standards, build onboarding guides, and run regular office hours to drive user adoption.

- Advance Data Strategy & Maturity: Support the enterprise data strategy through stakeholder synthesis and executive materials. Coordinate data maturity assessments, synthesize outputs into actionable recommendations, and deliver training programs to raise data literacy across the company.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- Experience: 5+ years in data governance, data management, or analytics. Proven track record of supporting or implementing governance programs (stewardship models, policy execution, catalog rollouts) and driving adoption in fast-moving, complex environments.

- Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA DMBOK).

- Working knowledge of modern data stack platforms (Snowflake, dbt, cloud data warehouses).

- Hands-on experience with data catalog/metadata management tools (e.g., DataHub, Alation, Atlan).

- Proficiency in SQL for governance reporting and data quality analysis.

- Leadership & Program Management: Exceptional workshop facilitation and consensus-building skills. High degree of organization with a track record of managing multiple workstreams and executing independently.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

- Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification (or active coursework).

- Hands-on experience with data observability tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR/CCPA, internal audit) or AI governance/responsible data practices.

- Prior experience in B2B SaaS or restaurant technology.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager-  Marketing Tools
jobs.description:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

About the role

Toast IQ Grow combines intelligent marketing tools with dedicated expert support to help restaurants reach more guests, bring them back, and grow sales. The Marketing Tools team builds the campaign products underlying Toast IQ Grow - one of the fastest-growing products in Toast's history. Every campaign created by a restaurant, a Toast marketing specialist or the Toast IQ Marketing Agent uses what this team builds.

Our purpose is simple:

- Build AI-powered marketing automation that drives orders and revenue for restaurants

- Give users the advanced tools they need to run best-in-class marketing programs

- Maintain a platform that scales seamlessly with billions of messages going out a year

We operate like a startup within Toast: fast-moving, customer-obsessed, and relentlessly focused on impact and results.

What you’ll do

This role is an incredible opportunity for a product leader who wants to shape how restaurants market in an AI-first world, on a platform that already sends billions of messages. Responsibilities include:

- Marketing automation: Lead the vision, strategy and roadmap for Toast's marketing experiences across email, SMS and social. Partner with our CRM team and own the marketing use cases that move restaurants from one-off sends to always-on campaigns that run themselves.

- Advanced tooling: Build the power-user layer for Toast's marketing specialists, multi-location brands, and sophisticated operators, including bulk and multi-location workflows, advanced scheduling and segmentation. Keep the core experience simple for everyone else.

- AI: Partner with the Toast IQ Marketing Agent team so that AI-generated campaigns are easy to review, edit, approve, and trust. Find where AI can remove work across the campaign lifecycle.

- Metrics: Own outcomes for your area, acting as the GM of the product space. You'll be accountable for campaigns sent, attributed revenue and marketing specialist efficiency.

- Teamwork: Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to define and deliver high-impact features.

- Customer empathy: Drive deep understanding through interviews, testing, analytics and insights, so we solve real problems for restaurants and the specialists who support them.

What we’re looking for

You love solving complex problems and embrace an iterative mindset. You are grounded in customer feedback and cross-functional partnership, and you can turn customer needs and product vision into world-class experiences. The ideal candidate has:

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of driving strategy, execution, and impact for B2B products

- Experience building platform products at scale, ideally in SaaS martech (email, SMS, push, or social)

- Experience building for both power users and novice users, and the judgment to know when to add flexibility and when to simplify

- Hands-on curiosity about AI and agentic products, and active use of AI tools in your own work

- Strong ability to turn data into actionable insights and customer outcomes

- Proven ability to influence across teams and drive alignment in ambiguous, high-impact spaces

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Delivery is one of the hardest parts of running a restaurant. Whether an order goes out with the restaurant's own driver or a Toast Delivery Services courier, a lot has to go right: the food has to be ready when the driver arrives, the right driver has to get the right order, and the guest needs to know where it is. When something slips, the restaurant has to make it right fast. Today much of that still depends on a manager watching a screen and making judgment calls in the middle of a rush.

Our vision is to make running delivery effortless: one place to dispatch, track and manage every delivery order. Because Toast sits at the center of the restaurant, we can see both sides of every delivery, the kitchen and the road. That lets us build smarter dispatch, catch problems before the guest notices, and use AI to take on the tedious work of exceptions and refunds.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

As a Senior PM on Delivery, you'll own that roadmap and ship it. You'll work closely with the Guest team on the consumer experience, and with POS, Order Management and Toast's AI teams. If you like technical problems that show up directly in a restaurant's dinner rush and a guest's evening, this is the role.

- Own the roadmap for your area of Toast Delivery, and decide what gets built next based on what makes delivery easier and more profitable for restaurants.

- Improve how orders get dispatched, whether to the restaurant's own drivers or Toast Delivery Services couriers, so food goes out on time and operators always know where things stand.

- Partner with the Guest team on the guest side of delivery: ordering, live tracking and quick resolution when something goes wrong.

- Take the manual work out of exceptions and refunds. Decide where AI helps and where simple rules work better, then ship it with guardrails operators can trust.

- Shape the next generation of delivery at Toast: AI-assisted dispatch, proactive alerts that catch problems before guests notice, and smarter ways to match delivery capacity to what the kitchen can handle.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

- A strong self-starter: you find the most important problem, get the context you need and move.

- A proven track record owning a product roadmap and driving measurable outcomes, not just shipping features.

- Technical fluency: you're comfortable going deep with engineers on integrations and data. You stay anchored on what it changes for the restaurant or guest.

- Strong instincts for the busy restaurant operator, someone running a dinner rush without an ops analyst, and for what makes a guest choose to order direct.

- Comfort working with external partners and integrations, where some of what shapes your product is outside your direct control.

- Experience in delivery, logistics, marketplaces or other real-time operational products is a plus.

Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.
